standout_why: None of the cited rival pages could be read today. WebFetch returned 'unable to fetch' for womenshealthmag.com, goodhousekeeping.com and wired.com, curl was not permitted, and wearablebeat.com returned 403. So this cannot be checked against what they say. Rival roundups commonly mention Oura's $5.99/mo fee, so the score is 1 (partly covered) rather than 2. The two-year total and the $99.99 no-subscription alternatives at the same price as ChatGPT's 'Fitbit Air $99.99' card are probably the new part.
decides: This confirms the cheaper end of our page's pick. For the 'Sleep, recovery, and cycle insights' and 'discreet, affordable' slots, the Amazfit Active 2 (Round) at $99.99 with no fee costs $99.99 over two years, against $538.98 for Oura Ring 5 plus membership. Oura wins only if the shopper wants a ring rather than a wrist device. Our page also lists 'Oura Ring 4', but ouraring.com now shows only the Ring 5, so that row should change to Ring 5 at $399 to $499. Apple Watch SE 3 starts at $249 on apple.com, not the $279 ChatGPT showed.
